title: risk.assessed payload, v1
description:
Published on `risk.assessed.v1` when a transaction has been scored and the assessment persisted.

Carries every version that contributed to the score - model, feature, and policy - because an assessment that cannot be attributed to the exact configuration that produced it cannot be defended, reproduced, or audited later.

Keyed by ACCOUNT id, matching `transaction.created.v1`, so an account's transactions and their assessments stay in order relative to one another.

accountId.description: The partition key for this topic.

ruleScore.description: Deterministic rule contribution, computed in the API inside the transaction.

modelScore.description: Model contribution, or null when the scoring service was unavailable and the assessment degraded to rules alone. Null is a real and expected outcome, not an error - see `degraded`.

finalScore.description: The combined score the risk band and any alert were derived from.

degraded.description: True when this assessment was produced without a model score. Explicit rather than inferred from `modelScore == null`, so a consumer filtering for degraded assessments does not have to encode that inference.

modelVersion.description: Version of the model that produced modelScore, or null when degraded.

featureVersion.description: Version of the feature pipeline. Two scores are only comparable when this matches.

policyVersion.description: Version of the thresholds and banding policy. Always present: banding happens even when the model does not.

reasonCodes.description: What drove the score, ordered by descending absolute contribution. Bounded at 20: an explanation an analyst cannot read is not an explanation.

scoringLatencyMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the scoring call, measured by the caller. Zero when degraded.

alertRaised.description: Whether this assessment opened an alert. The alert itself arrives on alert.created.v1; this lets a consumer avoid joining across topics to answer 'did anything happen'.
